# MatrixQR QR Code Generator

> MatrixQR is a free, secure, privacy-focused, and client-side QR code generator with a premium tech aesthetic.

## Main Tool

- [MatrixQR Studio](https://www.matrixqr.cc/): Generate WiFi, vCard, Text, and URL QR codes instantly. No data tracking, works completely offline.

## Core Features

- **Supported Types**: WiFi connection, vCard/Contact, URL/Website, Plain Text.
- **Privacy & Security**: Purely client-side execution using JavaScript. No user data, generated content, or logs are transmitted to any server.
- **Customization**: Supports logo overlay, custom colors, round/square module patterns, and high-resolution PNG/SVG exports.
- **Offline Capable**: Fully functional without an active internet connection.

## Key Technical Specs

- **Architecture**: Static Web Application (Client-Side Only).
- **Core Dependencies**: Pure JavaScript / Modern Web APIs.
- **Data Persistence**: Zero server storage.

## Optional / Full Documentation

- [Full Specification & Guide](https://www.matrixqr.cc/llms-full.txt): Complete feature specs, privacy architecture, and user guides for MatrixQR.
